description: Frozen statement, corpus/source contract and source hashes are explicit.
Claim is not used to construct the feature/test that is then cited as evidence for the same claim.
Training/selection/tuning does not inspect held-out units or outcomes used for evaluation.
Material confounds are controlled, crossed, residualised, or explicitly bound.
Null preserves the relevant opportunity structure; otherwise the result is descriptive only.
Comparator/control has matched information, capacity and tuning privileges appropriate to the claim.
Metric is not driven by degenerate variance, collapsed support, or an identity artefact.
Claim is replicated across required representations or explicitly scoped as frame-specific.
Thresholds, selection rules and model choices are frozen or subjected to sensitivity/adversarial tests.
For quantitative claims the effect and matched null SD (or exact finite bound) are stored; ratio<2 cannot support a resolving claim.
Independent fold/unit/representation replay or equivalent prospective replication supports the claim where applicable.
Every parent premise is certified or explicitly conditional; no open premise is silently promoted.
Exact evidence rows, source relation/version and reproducible extraction are recorded.
A concrete falsifier/kill rule or scope bound is recorded.
Contradicted/superseded prior findings are visible and cannot silently remain active.
Claim is a single auditable proposition or explicitly decomposed into certified component lemmas.
Runner/query/code path and source data are preserved sufficiently for an independent exact replay.
A context-free adversarial review (user rule 20) of the claim and its data has been run and recorded; no supportive context supplied to the reviewer.
